candidate_rq: strategy construction and risk allocation; does the frozen sparse cross-scorer event rule retain next-open value on genuinely new dates?

universe.policy: immutable first three members of every frozen sector; no substitution

news_and_timing.source: LSEG Workspace English-language headlines under the existing research licence
news_and_timing.event_mapping: first XNYS open at least 15 minutes after the first timestamp
news_and_timing.date_only_or_unknown_time: first XNYS session strictly after the stated date
news_and_timing.holding_interval: mapped open to immediately following XNYS open
news_and_timing.missing_immediate_next_open: drop the firm-open; never jump to a later observed stock date

gemma.role: event dates and positive/negative firm-open counts only
gemma.hard_fail: any model, provider, quantization, prompt, privacy, schema, or probability-validity mismatch

firm_open_aggregation.active_session: at least one positive-event firm and at least one negative-event firm

selection.long_names: top n_long FinBERT strongest_event ranks; symbol ascending breaks score ties
selection.short_names: bottom n_short FinBERT strongest_event ranks; symbol ascending breaks score ties

secondary_risk_diagnostic.name: inverse_volatility_same_schedule_and_names
secondary_risk_diagnostic.comparison_role: report risk, turnover, drawdown, and paired net difference versus the primary; do not select the strategy from this arm

minimum_evaluation_population.rule_if_not_met: stop without performance inference and continue prospective accumulation

cash_comparison.estimand: mean primary net return per complete calendar session
cash_comparison.pass: mean positive, interval lower bound above zero, and p < 0.05

primary_inference_and_gates.strategy_quality: positive net total return, break-even above 10 bps/side, and positive net Sharpe in both chronological halves
primary_inference_and_gates.factor_alpha: positive HAC(5) intercept with two-sided p < 0.05 in equal-weight market plus ten sector-minus-market model
primary_inference_and_gates.dependence: positive net return in every rebuilt leave-one-company and leave-one-sector-out replay
primary_inference_and_gates.promotion: all population, cash, strategy-quality, factor-alpha, and dependence gates pass; Gate F1 and the human label audit are separately satisfied

known_limitations: The OpenRouter model identifier and provider pin do not cryptographically pin hosted model weights.
Exact +1/-1 endpoints are scorer-calibration-sensitive; any scoring-contract mismatch fails closed rather than redefining the event.
The candidate was selected on an opened eight-month LSEG window and requires genuinely new dates for credible confirmation.
Raw next-open price returns exclude dividends and do not establish intraday availability beyond the conservative timing rule.
